headline: HoverAir’s transforming modular drone has already been halted in the US
summary: The HoverAir Versa drone has stopped taking US orders days after its debut. The FCC's drone ban appears to have struck again. US shipping may be abandoned for the modular device.

headline: TikTok will pay $400 million to settle DOJ child privacy lawsuit
summary: TikTok will pay $400 million to settle a US Department of Justice lawsuit. The suit alleged COPPA violations by collecting data from children without parental consent. TikTok also reportedly failed to delete these accounts.

headline: Over 1 million people have clicked LinkedIn’s AI slop button
summary: LinkedIn's 'Seems like AI slop' button has been clicked over a million times. The feature was announced on July 30th. It allows users to flag AI-generated content perceived as low quality.

headline: Apple is laying off staffers working on the Vision Pro and Siri
summary: Apple is reportedly laying off staff across its Siri and Vision Pro teams. This includes largely shutting down a Vision Pro gaming team. More than 200 jobs were cut, according to Bloomberg.

headline: GTA 6 U.S. Army Deal Has Already Convinced at Least 20 Soldiers to Reenlist
summary: A US Army base is offering time off for the Grand Theft Auto 6 launch. This incentive has led at least 20 soldiers to reenlist. The deal is offered at Fort Stewart, Georgia.

headline: Preorder SPECS, Snap's First-Ever AR Glasses
summary: Snap's new AR glasses, SPECS, are now available for preorder. They are described as a lightweight and stylish wearable computer. These mark Snap's first entry into AR glasses.

headline: Save $320 off Bose's Biggest and Most Immersive Soundbar With Dolby Atmos and TrueSpace Technology
summary: The Bose Smart Ultra soundbar is currently on sale. You can save $320 on this immersive sound system. It features Dolby Atmos and TrueSpace Technology.

headline: Save 70% Off Proton VPN's 2-Year Plan, Now Just $2.99
summary: Proton VPN is offering a 70% discount on its 2-year plan. The acclaimed VPN service is now available for just $2.99. This deal provides significant savings on a top-rated VPN.

headline: Girl, 6, dies days after Shoreham sea tragedy killed three family members
summary: A 6-year-old girl has died following a sea tragedy in Shoreham. Saja El-Khawas is the fourth fatality in her family from the incident. Her family got into difficulty in the West Sussex waters.

headline: Prince Harry and six others face privacy case legal bill of up to £34.5m
summary: Prince Harry and six co-claimants face a legal bill of up to £34.5 million. They lost a privacy case against the Daily Mail publisher. An initial £9.54 million is due within seven days.

headline: Russian double-tap drone strike kills 15 in Ukrainian mall, officials say
summary: A Russian double-tap drone strike has killed 15 people in a Ukrainian mall. At least 130 others, including 23 children, were injured. Officials confirmed the attack on the shopping center.

headline: Meghan in talks for role in Netflix series The Gentlemen, BBC understands
summary: Meghan Markle is reportedly in talks for a role in Netflix's 'The Gentlemen' series. This would mark her first significant acting role since marrying Prince Harry. The BBC understands these discussions are underway.
